title: At TechBBQ, Europe's AI conversations kept coming back to: Who's actually in control? | TechCrunch
summary: That question of sovereignty — which fittingly matched this year’s theme of “Emerging from Agency” — was especially timely after Anthropic’s AI models Mythos and Fable became unavailable to users outside Europe earlier this year.
